alpha_extraction_reference.use: Alpha only. Generated RGB was used only to find registration features and is never app character art.

registration.method: SIFT boot-detail matches followed by estimateAffinePartial2D/RANSAC; inverse warp of alpha with linear interpolation

mask_construction.lower_alpha: minimum of original alpha and registered generated extraction alpha; no dilation
mask_construction.dense_generated_to_original_flow: Rejected; not used because it distorted the ground boundary.

review: First/middle/last source and encoded frames reviewed for boots, soles, decorations, hair and hands. All 63 source frames checked for boot-core opacity and removed ground core. Matching neutral poster needed to avoid a ground patch appearing on entry/return.
reproduction: The stored registered grayscale matte makes video and poster preparation deterministic with the recorded dependencies; no new AI generation is required.
